answer: By requiring each participant to lock staking collateral in a vault and to pay non-refundable attestation fees that compound opportunity cost each epoch, the protocol forces an adversary's marginal expense to rise super-linearly. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay function binds the fee schedule to on-chain time, while slashing penalties proportional to the saffron stake amplify loss upon any deviating whisper of fraud, yielding a negative expected attack utility and establishing a strict Nash equilibrium where honest attestation dominates.
